components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Beveled Chess.com green primary CTA for room creation, invite join, and rematch.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn ds-btn-green ds-create-room-btn">Play a Friend (Create Link)</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #4d4a46); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 70ms ease; } .ds-btn-green { background: var(--green, #81b64c); border-color: var(--green-edge, #45752a); border-bottom-width: 3px; color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); } .ds-create-room-btn { height: 44px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-btn-green:hover { background: var(--green-hover, #95cc5a); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #81b64c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #4d4a46); background: var(--bg-elevated, #363430); color: var(--ink, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 70ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, #403e3a); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #81b64c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Subordinate dismissals, room leave, decline, and compact meta actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 70ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, #b8b6b2); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated, #363430); color: var(--ink, #ffffff); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #81b64c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Left Navigation Rail
components.description: Walnut left sidebar navigation with active highlight and green unread count badge.
components.css: .ds-left-nav { width: 152px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 10px; background: var(--bg-nav, #262522); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); } .ds-left-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, #b8b6b2); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-left-nav-item:hover, .ds-left-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--bg-elevated, #363430); color: var(--ink, #ffffff); } .ds-nav-count { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--green, #81b64c); color: #161512; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-left-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #81b64c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-strip-stack { width: 100%; max-width: 340px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 10px; background: var(--bg-main, #302e2b); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); } .ds-player-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; } .ds-player-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; } .ds-avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-avatar.is-white { background: var(--sq-light, #eeeed2); color: #262421; } .ds-avatar.is-black { background: #1f1e1b; color: #f3f3f3; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #4d4a46); } .ds-player-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-player-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink, #ffffff); } .ds-adv-val { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-muted, #b8b6b2); } .ds-clock { min-width: 104px; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background: var(--bg-deep, #21201d); color: var(--ink-muted, #b8b6b2); font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-clock.is-running { background: #ffffff; color: #21201d; }

components.css: .ds-timer-wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Figtree', sans-serif); } .ds-seg-tabs { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--bg-deep, #21201d); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); } .ds-seg-tab { padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, #b8b6b2); font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #ffffff); } .ds-seg-tab.is-active { background: var(--bg-elevated, #363430); color: var(--ink, #ffffff); } .ds-preset-grid { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; } .ds-preset-btn { padding: 7px 4px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, #4d4a46); background: var(--bg-deep, #21201d); color: var(--ink-muted, #b8b6b2); font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preset-btn:hover { color: var(--ink, #ffffff); background: var(--bg-elevated, #363430); } .ds-preset-btn.is-selected { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(129, 182, 76, 0.25); border-color: var(--green, #81b64c); } .ds-seg-tab:focus-visible, .ds-preset-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #81b64c); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
ChessArena adopts a familiar three-column online chess layout modeled after Chess.com: a narrow dark-walnut left navigation rail (`#262522`), a centered warm-charcoal board stage (`#302e2b`) anchoring a classic cream-and-sage `8x8` board (`#eeeed2` / `#769656`) between compact player clock strips, and a dense dark-espresso action sidebar (`#262421`) that transitions cleanly from pre-match setup into live algebraic notation, board controls, and room chat.

Cover credibility remains foundational: guests join via link or code with zero onboarding wall and zero visible trace of hidden tooling. Authorized accounts retain silent access to the fixed right-edge `Operator Console` drawer via `Ctrl+Shift+T` / `Cmd+Shift+T` or triple-clicking the `ChessArena` mark, and dismiss all concealed state in one stroke with `Esc`.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal-and-walnut tonal architecture (`#21201d` wells, `#262421` / `#262522` sidebars, `#302e2b` main arena, `#363430` interactive controls) with zero drop shadows across panels and cards.

Classic tournament cream-and-sage chessboard (`#eeeed2` / `#769656`) with inset corner rank/file coordinates, yellow-olive last-move highlights (`#f6f682` / `#baca44`), and translucent dark move dots/capture rings.
Tactile club-green primary CTAs (`#81b64c`) anchored by a `3px` deep-green bottom lip (`#45752a`) and paired with flat `Umber Elevated` (`#363430`) secondary controls.

High-contrast digital clock pills (`20px` `JetBrains Mono` tabular digits) that invert from recessed `Obsidian Well` (`#21201d`) at rest to `Pure Chalk Ink` (`#ffffff`) on `#21201d` text during the active turn.
Self-hosted variable `Figtree` (`300–900`) for compact UI chrome and `JetBrains Mono` (`400–700`) with `tabular-nums` for clocks, move notation, time-control presets, and badges.

rules.name: The Club Green CTA Rule
rules.body: `Tournament Green` (`#81b64c`) with its `Tournament Green Edge` (`#45752a`) bottom lip is reserved for primary game creation, match entry, rematch, invite copy, and live-status indicators; navigation and secondary board tools remain neutral umber.

rules.name: The Active-White Clock Flip Rule
rules.body: Standby clocks sit quietly in `Obsidian Well` (`#21201d`) with `Stone Muted Ink` (`#b8b6b2`) digits and snap cleanly to high-contrast `Pure Chalk Ink` (`#ffffff`) background with `#21201d` numerals when running, overriding to `#b33430` with `#ffffff` digits below 20 seconds.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock & Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every live-updating numeric string—clocks, move pair numbers, material delta (`+3`), unread counts, and engine evaluation—uses `JetBrains Mono` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so numbers never shift width mid-match.

rules.name: The Inset Coordinate Rule
rules.body: Rank (`8–1`) and file (`a–h`) labels sit inside the top-left of column `a` and bottom-right of row `1` at `10px` `Figtree` `700` (`line-height: 1`), inheriting the opposing square color (`--sq-dark` on light squares, `--sq-light` on dark squares).

rules.name: The Three-Column Arena Anchor Rule
rules.body: Desktop maintains `152px` navigation, a viewport-fitted `1:1` central board column (`min(640px, calc(100dvh - 134px))`), and a `376px` right panel so match entry, live notation, and board play never compete for vertical scroll.

rules.name: The Tonal Well & Bevel Rule
rules.body: Containers communicate depth through recessed `#21201d` wells inside `#262421` panels without cast shadows, while primary CTAs derive physical weight from their `3px` bottom border bevel.

rules.name: The Soft-Cornered Club Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interactive UI controls standardize on `4px` (`--radius-sm`) and overlay cards on `6px` (`--radius-md`), keeping individual squares orthogonal (`0px`) inside the `4px`-rounded board frame.

rules.name: The Concealed Operator Overlay Rule
rules.body: `OperatorDrawer` overlays the right sidebar at the exact `376px` desktop width using the same `#21201d` / `#262421` surface family, `4px` radius, `segmented-tabs`, and `.btn` hierarchy while never rendering any DOM nodes when `canTroll` is false.

dos: **Do** preserve the three-column Chess.com proportions (`152px 1fr 376px`), warm charcoal-walnut surfaces (`#302e2b` / `#262522` / `#262421` / `#21201d`), and `4px`/`6px` radii across new views and modals.
**Do** invert active digital clocks cleanly to `Pure Chalk Ink` (`#ffffff`) background with `#21201d` tabular `JetBrains Mono` digits, keeping standby clocks recessed in `Obsidian Well` (`#21201d`).
**Do** keep `Tournament Green` (`#81b64c`) with its `3px` `#45752a` bottom bevel for primary match actions while leaving navigation and board controls neutral umber.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` across transitions, piece nudges, and sync spinners (`0.01ms`).
**Do** gate all `OperatorDrawer`, evaluation bar, and hint-arrow markup behind `canTroll` so guests never see concealed tooling.
donts: **Don't** introduce `box-shadow` elevation, glassmorphism blur, or neon accents onto panels, modals, or board frames.
**Don't** break the `1:1` cream-and-sage board geometry (`#eeeed2` / `#769656`) or move coordinates outside the board squares.
**Don't** omit `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on clocks, algebraic move columns, or eval readouts.

**Don't** ship additional un-tokenized hex literals (such as `#f59e0b`, `#b33430`, `#e53935`, or `#f7f769`) or leave `Vesper64` naming leftovers in new surfaces; consolidate semantic alerts onto `:root` tokens and verify text contrast (note existing `#ffffff` on `#81b64c` CTAs and `#9e9c98` on `#f0f0ea` eval bars fall below WCAG AA 4.5:1).
